info.title: Carbon live internal assertion authority
info.description: Cloud independently verifies the original signed proof and reads current authority. Supports lifecycle POST, lifecycle-status GET and the ten signed Database data POST operations. Does not issue assertions or authorize arbitrary service actions.

post.description: Bearer contains the original signed compact assertion. Body is ignored and cancelled; clients may send {}. No cookies or browser CORS. Validates pinned database/registry audience, current session, account/membership revisions, grants, MFA and scope. Lifecycle writes additionally require the active operation, step and lease, canonical body digest and configuration revisions. Does not consume replay: the recipient owns durable replay protection. Data requests require an account principal, canonical Database path/query, a confirmed Database binding, exactly the operation-specific grant and current scoped access. App-user assertions remain denied until realm verification is implemented. Table catalog reads require metadata.read; only data mutations require fresh authentication.

200.description: Current authority decision; invalid or revoked proof returns current=false

404.description: Unknown path or unexpected query; current=false

503.description: Authority unavailable or not configured; current=false
